description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial Disputes between Free Trade Zones and General Service Employees Union Colombo 10 and other Part Sumithra Hasalaka (Pvt) Ltd, Haslaka and Wattala
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the appointment of an arbitrator under the Industrial Disputes Act to settle a labor dispute. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and exercises powers granted by statute. While it mentions Minister Manusha Nanayakkara, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory action being taken rather than constituting a government personnel appointment with detailed portfolio responsibilities. The core content is regulatory in nature, dealing with the legal framework for industrial dispute resolution.
